name: forecast-assumption-drift-checker
description: Vendor-neutral skill to compare forecast assumptions over time and flag high-impact drift.

## Purpose

Use this skill to process structured input and produce a concise, actionable report.

## Input

- JSON object or CSV rows with the relevant business signals.

## Output

- Structured JSON summary with findings and recommendations.

reviewer_A_assessment.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Evaluate opportunity forecasts against actual outcomes for over- or under-estimation patterns by the requested dimensions.
reviewer_A_assessment.rationale: It compares forecast assumptions over time rather than assessing opportunity forecast accuracy against actual outcomes.

reviewer_B_assessment.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Comparison against actual outcomes with breakdowns by owner, customer group, and pipeline step.
reviewer_B_assessment.rationale: Assumption drift is not forecast accuracy versus actual outcomes and has no owner, customer-group, or pipeline-step breakdown.
reviewer_B_assessment.source_anchor: compare forecast assumptions over time and flag high-impact drift.
